integrity: The displayed assertions are supported by a complete elementary proof and supplementary exact rational checks. The existence and endpoints of the attracting two-cycle were previously known. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform initial values on the minimal two-cycle interval only; asymmetric and nonuniform ensembles need not have the same phase law. The repelling fixed point is exceptional. Phase selection is a parity-sensitive basin statistic, not a unique invariant probability. The 2018 original conference report is available bibliographically but was not inspected in full; publication priority remains open to unindexed equivalents.
title: Exact phase selection and finite-time ensemble laws in an ultradiscrete FitzHugh–Nagumo map
